Since this technique requires the [[Starship|vessel]] to jump to [[lightspeed]], it must have a [[hyperdrive]]. |hdrange= |hdsystem= |poweroutput= |power= |shield gen= |hull= |sensor= |target= |navigation= |avionics= |maincomp= |countermeasures= |armament= |complement= |bays= |escapepods= |crew= |skeleton= |passengers= |capacity= |cargohandling= |consumables= |lifesupport= |communications= |othersystems= |role= |commission= |destroyed=[[35 ABY]], [[Endor system]]{{FilmDate|IX|the [[freighter]]'s [[Uprising on Endor|destruction]] in the [[Endor system]]}} |retired= |affiliation=[[Resistance]]{{InsiderCite|228|A Certain Point of View (department)}} |navy= |fleet= |owners= |captains= |registry= |aliases= }} {{Quote|That, my son, is a blessed sign of the Golden One.|translated=1|Wicket Warrick, to his son Pommet, following the freighter's sacrifice|''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''}} A [[Resistance]] '''heavy freighter''' was active in [[the galaxy]] during the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. Concurrently with the [[Battle of Exegol]]{{Film|IX}} in [[35 ABY]], the [[Bulk freighter|freighter]] came into contact with a [[First Order]] [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] above the [[Endor|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)|Endor]]. Utilizing a technique known as the [[Holdo maneuver]], the crew of the [[freighter]] rammed into the [[Star Destroyer]] at [[lightspeed]], sacrificing themselves to [[Uprising on Endor|destroy]] the fearsome [[Starship|vessel]]. The incident was witnessed by [[Ewok]]s [[Wicket Wystri Warrick|Wicket]] and [[Pommet Warrick]] from the [[moon]] below. Unaware of the identities of the crew of the freighter, Wicket believed that the Destroyer's destruction was a blessing from the [[Golden One]]. Pommet concluded that the collision was the work of his [[Parent|father's]] old friends, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[C-3PO]].''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' ==Behind the scenes== The heavy freighter first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], though only in the form of wreckage far off in [[Realspace|space]]. It was later identified as a heavy freighter in the [[2021]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''. ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} {{Wreck}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *{{InsiderCite|228|A Certain Point of View (department)}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Heavy freighters]] [[Category:Starships of the Resistance]]
